title: ADR-0019 D5 #4: continue the 12-crate decomposition (peel feature crates from hf)
objective: ADR-0019 D5 #4 (PRD §7.2 target): the hf monolith is being decomposed into the planned handoff-* crate layout. `handoff-core` (leaf primitives) was peeled in #154 and edition-2024/resolver-3 landed in #153. Continue peeling cohesive feature modules out of `hf/src/*` into their own crates that depend on `handoff-core` (candidates: drift, hooks, contract/gatekeeper, fleet, intake) — behavior-preserving moves with `hf` re-exporting so existing `crate::` paths stay valid, each its own PR, each verified green. The work is incremental; one or more feature crates per increment.
acceptance_criteria: ADR-0019 D5 #4: continue the 12-crate decomposition (peel feature crates from hf): implemented + cargo test green + checkpointed
